name: Larkspur estate
description: A fictional financial-services group's control posture as its systems export it each day (ADR 0020): the organisation and its leaders from HR, about 2,400 applications from the CMDB, the cloud inventory, 46 shared platforms, a catalogue of 14 controls mapped to the frameworks, the risk register, the findings ledger and twelve evidence feeds. This first notebook is the bronze layer: every feed judged as it arrives. A synthetic dataset: no real company or person is its subject.

sources.description: The HR system's daily extract of the organisation: every unit (the group, its segments, business units, departments and teams) with its parent, its leader, and anyone acting for a vacant or absent one
The leaders in the HR extract: each with their title, manager, unit and status (active, on leave, or left in the last thirty days)
The CMDB's applications: the owning team, tier, exposure, data class, datastore, hosting, site, runtime platform and lifecycle, with when each record last changed
The cloud inventory: resources counted by application tag in each account

The GRC tool's control catalogue: each control's CSF 2.0 function and category, weight and cadence, which applications it applies to, what it depends on, what compensates for it and the kind of platform that provides it
Each control mapped to framework requirements (NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, PCI DSS v4.0.1, SOC 2), with how the two relate
The risk register: every version of every exception, with its approver, reason, validity and status that day
The vulnerability scanners and penetration tests: open findings, those fixed in the last thirty days, and one scan-information row an application scanned, saying whether the scanner logged in

TLS on exposed endpoints: the ingress, the certificate's issuer, the protocol offered and the certificate's expiry. One row an application it applies to (live internet- and partner-facing applications)
The web application firewall in front of internet-facing applications: its ingress, its mode and its ruleset’s age. One row an application it applies to
Yearly penetration tests for exposed tier 1 and 2 applications: the last test, the next due date and the open high findings
Encryption at rest for applications with a datastore: the store and its key store
Yearly key rotation for regulated data: the key store, the last rotation, the next due date and the key's age
Backups for the applications we host that keep data: the controller, the last job's state, the last success and the recovery point
Yearly disaster-recovery exercises for tier 1 applications: the last exercise, the next due date and whether the recovery time was met
MFA for every live application: the identity provider, the share of users registered and whether MFA is enforced. Registered is not enforced
Quarterly access reviews for applications with confidential or regulated data: the last review, the next due date, the reviewers and the access revoked
Central logging for the applications we host: the pipeline, the forwarder's certificate issuer, the last event received and the retention
Privileged accounts of tier 1 and 2 applications: the vault, the accounts, and how many are not vaulted
Endpoint detection on the hosts of the applications we host: hosts, hosts reporting, hosts in reduced functionality and the sensor version
The architecture inventory: each shared platform, its kind and its site
What each platform depends on, and the controls it provides to the applications on it (common or hybrid)

objectTypes.name: Organisational unit
objectTypes.title: name
objectTypes.description: A unit of the organisation: the group, a segment, a business unit, a department or a team

objectTypes.name: Application
objectTypes.title: name
objectTypes.description: An application of the CMDB: what every evidence feed’s rows are one each of

objectTypes.name: Platform
objectTypes.title: name
objectTypes.description: A shared platform applications run on or rely on

properties.title: Unit
properties.description: The organisational unit's id in the HR system

properties.title: Parent unit
properties.description: The unit this one reports into; blank for the group

properties.title: Level
properties.description: The unit's place in the organisation

properties.title: Leader
properties.description: The person leading the unit; blank while the post is vacant

properties.title: Acting leader
properties.description: Who acts for a vacant post or an absent leader; blank when no one is named

properties.title: Cost centre
properties.description: The unit's cost centre

properties.title: Person
properties.description: The person's id in the HR system

properties.title: Name
properties.description: The person's name

properties.title: Title
properties.description: Their job title

properties.title: Manager
properties.description: Who they report to: the leader of the unit above, or whoever acts for it

properties.title: In role since
properties.description: When they took up the post

properties.title: Status
properties.description: Whether the person is active, on leave, or left in the last thirty days

properties.title: Application
properties.description: The application's id in the CMDB

properties.title: Name
properties.description: What it is called

properties.title: Owning team
properties.description: The team accountable for the application

properties.title: Tier
properties.description: How critical the application is to the business: 1 the most

properties.title: Exposure
properties.description: Who can reach it: anyone on the internet, partners, or only staff

properties.title: Data class
properties.description: The most sensitive data it holds

properties.title: Keeps data
properties.description: Whether it has a datastore of its own

properties.title: Hosting
properties.description: Where it runs

properties.title: Site
properties.description: The cloud region or data centre it runs in

properties.title: Platform
properties.description: The shared platform it runs on, or the platform a link starts from

properties.title: Lifecycle
properties.description: Where it is in its life

properties.title: Created
properties.description: When the record was created

properties.title: Go-live
properties.description: When it went live, or will

properties.title: Retire by
properties.description: When it is to be retired; blank when no date is set

properties.title: Updated
properties.description: When the record last changed

properties.title: Account
properties.description: The cloud account

properties.title: Region
properties.description: The cloud region

properties.title: Cluster
properties.description: The production cluster, blank outside production

properties.title: Application tag
properties.description: The application id the resources are tagged with, as the cloud has it: not always one the CMDB knows

properties.title: Resources
properties.description: How many resources carry the tag in the account

properties.title: Control
properties.description: The control's id in the catalogue

properties.title: CSF function
properties.description: The NIST CSF 2.0 function

properties.title: CSF category
properties.description: The NIST CSF 2.0 category

properties.title: Weight
properties.description: How much the control counts in a score, 1 to 3

properties.title: Cadence
properties.description: How often the control is met

properties.title: Depends on
properties.description: The control this one needs to pass first

properties.title: Compensated by
properties.description: What may stand in for the control when it fails

properties.title: Provided by
properties.description: The kind of platform that provides the control to the applications on it

properties.title: Allocation
properties.description: Who provides the control: a platform (common), a platform and the application (hybrid), or the application alone (system)

properties.title: Framework
properties.description: The framework the requirement belongs to

properties.title: Requirement
properties.description: The requirement's reference in its framework

properties.title: Relationship
properties.description: How the control relates to the requirement, in NIST IR 8477’s words

properties.title: Exception
properties.description: The exception's id in the risk register

properties.title: Version
properties.description: The version of the exception: an extension is a new version

properties.title: Approver
properties.description: Who approved the version

properties.title: Reason
properties.description: Why the risk was accepted

properties.title: Compensating control
properties.description: What stands in for the control meanwhile

properties.title: Valid from
properties.description: When the version takes effect

properties.title: Valid to
properties.description: When the version expires

properties.title: First expiry
properties.description: An extension keeps the date the exception first expired

properties.title: Approved
properties.description: When the version was approved

properties.title: Status
properties.description: The version's status that day

properties.title: Finding
properties.description: The finding's id as the scanner reports it

properties.title: Found by
properties.description: The scanner or a penetration test

properties.title: Scanner
properties.description: The scanner that reported it

properties.title: Check
properties.description: The scanner's check that found it; SCAN-INFO is the row saying an application was scanned

properties.title: CVE
properties.description: The vulnerability it is

properties.title: Severity
properties.description: How severe the scanner says it is

properties.title: Status
properties.description: The finding's status, as the scanner writes it

properties.title: First found
properties.description: When the scanner first found it

properties.title: Last found
properties.description: When the scanner last saw it

properties.title: Fixed
properties.description: When it was fixed; blank while open

properties.title: Due
properties.description: The day it must be fixed by: its severity's SLA from when it was first found

properties.title: Logged in
properties.description: On the scan-information row: whether the scanner logged in to the hosts. A scan that did not finds far less

properties.title: Status
properties.description: The control's status as its own tool reports it, before exceptions and compensation

properties.title: Endpoint
properties.description: The address the certificate is for

properties.title: Ingress
properties.description: The shared ingress in front of the application

properties.title: Issuer
properties.description: The certificate authority that issued the endpoint's certificate

properties.title: Protocol
properties.description: The TLS version offered

properties.title: Expires
properties.description: When the certificate expires

properties.title: Private link
properties.description: Whether a partner reaches it over a private link

properties.title: Mode
properties.description: What the firewall does with a bad request

properties.title: Ruleset age
properties.description: Days since its rules were updated

properties.title: Last test
properties.description: When it was last tested

properties.title: Next due
properties.description: When the next one is due; while overdue, the date it missed

properties.title: Tester
properties.description: Who tests it

properties.title: Open highs
properties.description: High findings from its tests still open

properties.title: Store
properties.description: The kind of datastore

properties.title: Key store
properties.description: Where its keys are kept

properties.title: Encrypted
properties.description: Whether the data is encrypted at rest

properties.title: Last rotated
properties.description: When its key was last rotated

properties.title: Key age
properties.description: Days since the key was rotated

properties.title: Controller
properties.description: The backup controller or service that backs it up

properties.title: Last job
properties.description: The last backup job's state

properties.title: Last success
properties.description: When a backup last completed

properties.title: Recovery point
properties.description: How old the newest backup may be

properties.title: Last exercise
properties.description: When it was last exercised

properties.title: Recovery time met
properties.description: Whether the last exercise recovered in time

properties.title: Identity provider
properties.description: Where its users sign in; local is its own sign-in

properties.title: Registered
properties.description: The share of its users registered for MFA: registered is not enforced

properties.title: Enforced
properties.description: Whether a policy enforces MFA

properties.title: Last review
properties.description: When its access was last reviewed

properties.title: Reviewers
properties.description: Who reviewed it

properties.title: Revoked
properties.description: Access removed at the last review

properties.title: Pipeline
properties.description: The log pipeline its logs go through

properties.title: Forwarder issuer
properties.description: The certificate authority behind its log forwarder's certificate

properties.title: Last event
properties.description: When its last log event arrived

properties.title: Retention
properties.description: How long its logs are kept

properties.title: Vault
properties.description: The privileged access vault

properties.title: Privileged accounts
properties.description: Its privileged accounts

properties.title: Not vaulted
properties.description: Privileged accounts outside the vault

properties.title: Hosts
properties.description: The hosts it runs on

properties.title: Reporting
properties.description: Hosts whose sensor reported

properties.title: Reduced functionality
properties.description: Hosts whose sensor runs in reduced functionality mode: not coverage

properties.title: Sensor version
properties.description: The EDR sensor's version

properties.title: Kind
properties.description: What kind of platform it is

properties.title: Relation
properties.description: What the link says: the platform depends on another, or provides a control

properties.title: Target
properties.description: The platform depended on, or the control provided
